messages:
Ravi: heads-up—trying a keyboard-first compact view for the Private setup network step. idea: condense probe rows, show minimal status icons and an expandable 'details' row for commands/logs.
Maya: I like compact for power users. but we need a clear affordance for newcomers: suggest a 'Show tips' inline toggle and a persistent help link at top.
Ethan: copy nit: avoid jargon. replace 'probe' with 'connection check' in UI copy. also prefer 'Run diagnostics' CTA vs 'View logs'.
Zoe: accessibility: collapsed details must be reachable by keyboard. when details open, focus should move into the content and the escape key should close it. also ensure status icons have text labels for screen readers.
Ravi: UX edgecases: if multiple checks fail, show a concise error summary at the top of the step with CTAs: "Retry checks" and "Get help". clicking "Get help" opens a side panel with copy + prefilled diagnostics command.
Maya: tone discussion: should help copy be 'diagnostic' (lists commands) or 'actionable' (one-click fixes)? we can't auto-fix network, so prefer step-by-step actionable guidance and copy snippets to paste.
Ethan: implementation: lazy-load heavy content and only fetch per-check logs when a user expands that check. track metric: % users who expand details after a failure.
Zoe: a11y extras: use aria-live polite for the summary when it appears, but debounce announcements. provide visually hidden context like '2 checks failed' for quick SR summary.
Ravi: decision proposal: compact rows by default, 'Show tips' toggle visible, auto-open details on first failure for new users, persist user preference. update all UI copy to use 'connection check' + 'Run diagnostics' CTA.
Maya: I'll draft copy variants (concise vs explanatory) and post in Figma.
